## Why This Is Asked

Tests understanding of DR in a multi-account setup, basic AWS services, and how to automate failover with minimal intervention.

- Route 53 failover routing
- Cross-region replication (S3, DynamoDB Global Tables)

- Rollback planning and pre-prod testing

## Code Example

```javascript
// Pseudo code for DR switch
function promoteSecondary() {

  // Reconfigure services to point to secondary endpoints
  updateConfig('/config/service-endpoints', 'secondary')
}
```

## Follow-up Questions
